faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Orders placed before 2 pm (CET) ship the same business day. Delivery takes 1-3 business days in Germany and 3-6 business days to the rest of the EU.

faqs.question: How much is shipping?
faqs.answer: Shipping is free on orders over 50 EUR. Below that it is 4.90 EUR in Germany and 9.90 EUR to other EU countries.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery. Start a return at northwind-demo.example/returns - the return label is free inside Germany and refunds are issued within 5 business days after we receive the parcel.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Klarna (pay in 30 days). Business customers can pay by invoice.

faqs.question: Where is my order?
faqs.answer: You will find the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email. You can also check the live status at northwind-demo.example/track with your order number and email address.

faqs.question: How do your sizes fit?
faqs.answer: Our jackets and boots fit true to size. Each product page has a size chart with exact measurements; if you are between two sizes we recommend the larger one.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty?
faqs.answer: All products have a 2-year warranty. Tents and backpacks from our own brand come with a 5-year warranty on seams and zips.

faqs.question: When can I reach a person?
faqs.answer: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00 (CET), at +49 30 000 000 (demo number) or by replying to this message.
